meta_title: SMV Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Woking
meta_description: SMV Heating & Plumbing is your trusted Gas Safe registered engineer in Woking. Fast boiler repairs, installations, and emergency callouts. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at the weekend? We're here same day. Fast diagnosis, honest pricing, no surprise call-out fees.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Woking
services_subhead: From routine boiler servicing to emergency pipe repairs and full system installations, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler safe and efficient—we diagnose faults fast and carry parts on the van for most same-day fixes.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: New condensing boilers cut your heating bills by up to 35%. We fit, commission, and offer 10-year warranties on all installations.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, frozen pipes, and leaks don't wait—neither do we. We're out 24/7 to stop water damage before it costs more.

services.title: Heating System Power Flushing
services.desc: Dirty water in your pipes reduces boiler efficiency and lifespan. Power flushing restores flow and can save hundreds in fuel costs.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Replacing an old system? We design, install, and balance new heating rigs to maximise warmth and minimise bills.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Cold spots, leaks, or noise? We repair or swap radiators—quick jobs often finished before lunch without draining your system.

about_pullquote: We started because we were tired of seeing customers overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: SMV Heating & Plumbing was founded by engineers who'd worked for big corporate outfits and saw too many customers pay through the nose for basic jobs. We set up in Woking to offer the same expertise at honest prices—no upselling, no jargon, just a fair day's work for a fair day's money. Over 15 years we've built a loyal base across Woking, Addlestone, and the surrounding villages by turning up on time, doing the job right, and explaining what we're doing every step.
about_para_2: Homeowners come back to us because they trust us. We don't recommend boiler replacement unless yours is actually beyond repair, and we stand behind every installation with a decade-long parts and labour warranty. Our reputation is built on speed (most emergencies resolved same day), transparency (no hidden fees), and the fact that we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own.
reviews_heading: What Woking Homeowners Say About SMV

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a Friday evening in December—nightmare timing. Called SMV at 6pm and they were here by 7:15. Mark diagnosed a dodgy valve, replaced it, and had the heating back on before we'd finished dinner. Didn't even charge extra for the evening callout. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced last month. Very thorough job, and the engineer explained everything clearly. No hard sell for a new one even though mine's getting on a bit. Just honest advice. Definitely booking them again next year.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Burst pipe on a Sunday morning. Rang SMV expecting a premium charge, but they came out promptly, fixed it properly, and the bill was reasonable. No cowboy tactics. Really impressed. Already recommended them to two neighbours.
reviews.author: James P.
